Bobyv87, the IT's will not allow price to hit the MPL all the time or
most of the time. They will turn price around some where inside the
kink so that people cannot figure them out. So don't expect price to
hit the MPL all the time. If you do so, then expect to miss out on may
trades, (as IF has stated, he misses out on many trades because he is
waiting at the MPL). That is the reason why IF said to put a position
in at the bottom of the FL and one at the MPL. At least this way you
will get in the trade and not miss it.
